name: snoutdata-studio-oss
description: The data workbench: your databases, your files, and the coding agent you already use, in one desktop app.
author: Built from source <nobody@example.invalid>

scripts.packages:install: npm --prefix ../../packages/review-core ci && npm --prefix ../../packages/move ci && npm --prefix ../../packages/client ci
scripts.dev: npm run review:build && npm run move:build && npm run client:build && npm run server:build && electron-vite dev
scripts.build: npm run review:build && npm run move:build && npm run client:build && npm run server:build && node --max-old-space-size=6144 ./node_modules/electron-vite/bin/electron-vite.js build && node scripts/third-party-licenses.mjs
scripts.package:dir: npm run rebuild:native && npm run build && node scripts/assert-build.mjs && electron-builder --dir && node scripts/assert-build.mjs --package
scripts.package: npm run rebuild:native && npm run build && node scripts/assert-build.mjs && electron-builder && node scripts/assert-build.mjs --package
scripts.release: node scripts/assert-build.mjs --release && npm run rebuild:native && npm run build && node scripts/assert-build.mjs && electron-builder --publish always && node scripts/assert-build.mjs --package
scripts.typecheck: npm run review:build && npm run move:build && npm run client:build && npm run typecheck:node && npm run typecheck:web && npm run typecheck:public && npm run typecheck:e2e
scripts.test: npm run review:build && npm run move:build && npm run client:build && npm run server:build && npm run server:tests && node -e "require('electron')" && node --test "out/tests/**/*.test.js"
